dek: The Hong Kong Economic and Trade Office in Singapore (Singapore ETO) is sponsoring and supporting the Asian Youth Orchestra (AYO) in presenting two concerts in Hanoi, Vietnam on August 12 and 13 as part of its 2026 Asian Concert Tour. The goal is to foster cultural exchanges and deepen people-to-people ties between Hon
